title: JB - "THE NETHER"
description: You didn't know you needed it. Thank me later. Now Jack Black will welcome you to the nether!
body:
# JB - THE NETHER
Let's bring a fraction from the Minecraft Movie to your Minecraft World!

### What can I expect?
With this mod, only a single thing will be added. Jack Black will now welcome you with his famous voice line "THE NETHER" whenever you switch the dimension

### More ideas?
If you desire more voicelines and can provide them, let me know and I may add them as well
